reviews.title: Don't Sub until the bug is fixed!
reviews.text:
bought two cameras as they were advertised as allowing live view without a subscription. That worked initially, but after a few weeks the feature became available only to paid subscribers.

After subscribing for one of the cameras (£30/year), I’m still experiencing several issues:
	1.	Each motion recording only lasts 10 seconds, even when there is continuous movement outside.
	2.	The detection accuracy is poor — sometimes it fails to record events.
	3.	Motion detection keeps turning off automatically, and I have to reset it every 3–5 days.
	4.	The human detection zones don’t work properly. Even though I selected only the area outside my door, it still detects movement far beyond that, which drains the battery.

Overall, it’s not reliable given the amount I’ve paid. I’ll wait to see if any updates fix these issues; otherwise, I will raise a claim via the App Store to request a refund.
